summary.allegation: The issuer says the cardholder paid TerraFreight Logistics GBP 412.75 for a freight collection and delivery, and that the shipment was never collected, so no service was received.
summary.to_defend: The merchant must show proof that the shipment was collected and delivered for this transaction, dated before the chargeback, to an address matching the cardholder's records.

requirements.title: Proof of delivery or service
requirements.text: Proof of delivery (tracking + carrier confirmation) or proof of service rendered (access logs, attendance, completed booking).
requirements.finding: The manifest records consignment TF-9051 tied directly to this transaction reference (txn_7745MN), collected from LS1 4DT at 11:30 on 22 April 2025 and delivered to LS9 8AA at 17:14 the same day, signed for by warehouse staff with a POD image on file. TerraFreight is itself the carrier, so its telematics and POD record is the carrier confirmation; note the POD image itself was not attached.

justification: Represent: R1 is satisfied by the carrier's own collection and delivery record for consignment TF-9051 explicitly referencing txn_7745MN, with R2 and R3 also met.
rationale:
The cardholder claims the freight shipment was never collected and no service was provided.
TerraFreight's operational manifest records consignment TF-9051, referenced to transaction txn_7745MN, collected from LS1 4DT at 11:30 on 22 April 2025 and delivered to LS9 8AA at 17:14 the same day, signed for by warehouse staff with POD image POD-9051-img on file.
The collection and delivery postcodes match the billing and shipping addresses held on the authorisation record for the GBP 412.75 charge of 22 April 2025.
The transaction was 3DS authenticated with a full AVS match and a CVV match from a UK IP address.
Service was rendered on 22 April 2025, three weeks before the 14 May 2025 chargeback, and the dispute should be reversed.
